newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenyan tea prices advance on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenyan tea prices advance on strong demand.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were firm on Monday boosted by strong demand at the weekly auction in Mombasa, auction officials said.

BP1s of all descriptions gained up to 12 U.S. cents while coloury mediums were up 4-6 cents. Brightest PDUSTs gained 9 cents while lower mediums were 5-12 cents dearer with selected lines advancing further. Bright liquoring Fannings and Dusts were dearer.
Pakistan and Egypt were strong, while Britain was showing interest. Sudan and Yemen were very active.
